column1: # Altin Peak: the miner's condition after the rescue.

column3:
I heard the roof crack.
I thought we'd die
under that stone.{page_break}My hands won't stop
shaking.{end_wait}
He's still in shock.\nDon't press him for\nanswers yet.{end_wait}
The others made it out.\nWe'll stay with him\nuntil he can walk.{end_wait}
Will you stay until\nhe can stand?{end_now}
Thank you. I just need\na little more time.{end_wait}
We can't remain here.\nThe roof may collapse.\nHelp him to his feet.{end_wait}
